bounds.domain: One active half-duplex owner, one initial capture, one submitted turn, one replacement capture and one Stop. A replacement can open after the turn drains or after idle Unmute. Mute and Unmute can change while an operation is pending.
bounds.assumptions: A reply's send, reply and playback drain are abstracted to a single owned turn. The case starts with its first capture admitted. The current capture's direct cancel is synchronous in this case. A capture acquired after retirement joins the old acquisition until its asynchronous cancel settles. Close and reopen can succeed or reject.
bounds.limitations: The maintained tests drive the actual controller with controlled clock, capture, reply and playback ports. The model excludes physical audio, cancellation failure recovery, multiple Stop callers, owner replacement, open-microphone mode and overlapping submission during Unmute acquisition. Stop settlement concerns the owned promises, with native cleanup outside the model.

assumptions: No fairness. A retired generation can only settle its prior work. It cannot send another turn or adopt or request capture.

Weak fairness of eligible reopen admission, host close and reopen settlement, late cancellation settlement and Stop acknowledgement. Mute or Stop can remove reopen eligibility. No wall-clock bound is assumed.
No fairness. An opening, close or late cancellation can stay pending and keep Stop waiting.
